policy: Exact-byte visual review of every raw automatic raster failure. This records reviewed rendering differences, never changes raw pass/fail metrics and never waives semantic, missing glyph, ordering, geometric, MathML, clipping or native/SVG consistency failures. The original denominator remains unchanged. Root reviewed pages1-8 and17-21; layout agent reviewed pages9-16 plus individual critical pairs.
